name: scala-notebook-shadow
description: Shows Metals compile diagnostics as squiggles in Scala Jupyter notebook cells via a hidden Mill shadow script.

scalaNotebook.scalaVersion.description: Scala version written into the shadow file's `//| scalaVersion` header. Must match the kernel you run, otherwise phantom errors.

scalaNotebook.mvnDeps.description: Mill coordinates written into the shadow file's `//| mvnDeps` header, e.g. com.lihaoyi::upickle:4.0.2. Merged with dependencies discovered from `import $ivy` lines.

scalaNotebook.preamble.description: Lines inserted after the header, before the first cell (e.g. Almond predef imports).

scalaNotebook.shadowDir.description: Directory, relative to the first workspace folder, where shadow .scala files are written.

scalaNotebook.debounceMs.description: Milliseconds to debounce shadow file regeneration after a notebook edit.

scalaNotebook.compileOnCreate.description: Run `./mill <shadowPath>:compile` once when a shadow file is first created. Only needed if Metals/Mill require it before reporting diagnostics for a brand-new script (see README Phase 0 findings).
